repo_notes.content: Deprecated on npm as of 2026-02-27 and marked private in package.json. The wiki must say so on the first page: readers arriving from a search result need to know before they copy anything.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: The repo is now a reference collection. Its useful content is the Dockerfiles, the egress policy script and the generator that emits them.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

pages.title: Status and Overview
pages.purpose: That this package is deprecated on npm and is now a template collection, what to use instead, and what remains worth copying.

pages.title: Image Generation
pages.purpose: The generator under src/generator.ts: what it emits, the options it accepts, and the shape of a generated Dockerfile.

pages.title: Validation
pages.purpose: The validator under src/validator.ts: the rules a generated or hand-written image must satisfy, and how failures are reported.

pages.title: Build and Deploy Scripts
pages.purpose: The scripts under scripts/: build, run, deploy, the agent egress policy, and the OIDC test trigger.

pages.title: Kubernetes Examples
pages.purpose: The Kubernetes examples and how a generated image is expected to be scheduled.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: The unit tests and the agent-image integration test, including what the integration test needs from its host.
